message: Bannerbear is an API and template tool that renders branded images, videos and PDFs automatically from data you already keep in tools like Airtable or a Zapier trigger, instead of each asset being laid out by hand. Verified product facts support this first-email scope: Introduce Bannerbear and point the reader to one next step: start the free trial with 30 API credits and no credit card, build one branded image template in the single trial workspace, and connect it to their own data via a native integration, Zapier or the REST API to render a first small batch of product banners or social posts automatically. Draft this documented use. Treat recipient circumstances as unconfirmed.
